description: This Java class 'CsvUtils' provides utility methods for reading CSV data into Java objects using Jackson's CSV dataformat. It encapsulates CSV parsing logic, including setup of the CsvMapper and schema, and offers a static method to read CSV content from an InputStream and map it to a list of specified class instances.

classes.name: CsvUtils
classes.description: A utility class for CSV operations, including reading CSV data into Java objects.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Generic method that reads CSV data from an InputStream and deserializes it into a list of objects of specified class type.
